Items: Browns Dairy peaches & cream yoghurt (about 170 g), a latte in a tall cup (about 300 ml, probably with whole milk), and a toasted English muffin with ham and cheese.

Estimates for what was served:
- Yoghurt, 170 g: about 160 kcal, 6 g protein, 27 g carbs, 3 g fat.
- Latte, about 300 ml: about 130 kcal, 7 g protein, 10 g carbs, 7 g fat.
- Muffin with ham and cheese: about 320 kcal, 08 g... specifically 18 g protein, 30 g carbs, 14 g fat.

Total served is about 610 kcal. The photo was taken before eating, so I can't see what is left over. I assumed the person leaves a small amount, about 5%, which is roughly 30 kcal. That puts the amount eaten at about 580 kcal. Scaling the macros by the same 5% gives about 29 g protein, 64 g carbs and 23 g fat.
